title: Kip Gets a Den
lines: Ten kids sit in the sun.
Kip is a pup. Kip naps in the mud.
Kim gets sad. The mud is not a bed.
"Kip can get a den," said Kim.
The kids get a big tin bin and mats.
Kim tips the bin and sets mats in it.
Kip gets in. It fits! Kip naps.
"Kim did it," said a kid, and Kim nods.

questions.ask: Where was Kip napping at the start?
questions.listenFor: In the mud. Line two says it. That is the problem Kim notices.

questions.ask: What did the kids use to make Kip a den?
questions.listenFor: A big tin bin and some mats. Lines five and six say it. Let your child reread rather than telling them.

questions.ask: Which part will you draw — Kip in the mud, or Kip in his new den?
questions.listenFor: Either, as long as they say what made them pick it. Line two is the mud; line seven is the den.
